recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It closes the remaining current-build computable metadata gap for FHIR-34316 while preserving the later FHIR-48833 CodeableReference decision; any broader AdverseEvent ModelInfo cleanup should be handled separately.
issue_request: FHIR-34316 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 AdverseEvent. It asked to add Observation to the scope of AdverseEvent.resultingCondition, and the accepted resolution renamed the element to resultingEffect and supported Reference(Condition | Observation).
initial_application: The issue was applied by cd56c64aad2d9729209bf8268b4d6d9ee494714e, which renamed the AdverseEvent StructureDefinition element and added Observation as a target, and by 03c97a14f97d78ce86c5a466a31fa5e17037585f, which renamed the search parameter. Current resource and search-parameter source already used resultingEffect, but the active FHIR ModelInfo Library still exposed resultingCondition.
additional_context: FHIR-48833 later changed AdverseEvent.resultingEffect to CodeableReference, so the current computable model surface needs CodeableConcept-or-Reference choices rather than the original Reference-only shape. AdverseEvent and Library are active in source/fhir.ini, and Library/library-fhir-model-definition is registered as an active example. Confluence minutes were consistent with the AdverseEvent/Observation discussion, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml so AdverseEvent ModelInfo exposes resultingEffect as a list of CodeableConcept-or-Reference choices and removed the stale resultingCondition property. Resynchronized source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so its embedded Library.content.data matches the raw ModelInfo content.
